resolved_failures.cause: The RAM busy update retained the page-walk dirty bit, but TR cached the earlier read image.
resolved_failures.fix: Build the TR cache from the descriptor consumed by the prepared busy operation.

limitations: Original CPU comparisons cover the available Intel hybrid host in protected code16/code32 with legacy paging and PAE, including CPL 0-3. Other vendors require qualification.
SLDT dword zero-extension is the bound modern target choice. Null LLDT leaves unusable hidden fields opaque; comparisons only require its selector and unusable bit.
ExclusiveTable owns one CPU and ordinary RAM. Concurrent CPUs, DMA, MMIO and physical bus-lock observation are outside this contract. Loading TR does not implement task switching.
The self-referential descriptor/page-table alias case is physically qualified in legacy paging. PAE fault/width/cache matrices do not imply that high-physical-address alias case.
Exact prefix/extent admission is strict. Malformed/unsupported bytes are admission errors, not an arbitrary-byte #UD emulator.
Generated protected C executes on Linux x64 through the shared state executor. The separate i386 source-dispatch lane remains compile-only.
Initial dirty-tree probes, the retained failed alias observation and focused repair runs are excluded from the final counts.
